audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart reads Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Shen in both layers, while every one of the seven whys under it says Yone wins that stage — 'keeping you ahead', 'you retain full lane control', 'you out-DPS Shen in any 1v1'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Yone on all seven rows and matches the whys exactly. The chart tokens are the part that is wrong, not the text. This is the two-layers-one-row problem: a paying player sees 'Shen' on the row and 'you out-trade him' underneath it.
audit.corrected: Flip all seven rows to Yone in both layers, with ratings raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Shen's real constraint — energy — is never mentioned.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and costs 150 energy; Twilight Assault costs 140 down to 100; Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1; Stand United is 200/180/160s. A Shen who taunts has spent most of his bar and cannot follow with an empowered Q.
audit.corrected: Write Shadow Dash's 18s and 150-energy cost as the window, and Stand United's 200s as the map clock to punish.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors: 'Vorpal Blade' is named twice as Shen's sustain, Yone's Spirit Cleave is called a 'true-damage cleave', and Stand United's channel is never flagged as interruptible.
audit.why: Vorpal Blade is not in Shen's kit at all — his passive is Ki Barrier, and Riot's text describes a shield after casting a spell, not healing. Telling a player to out-race healing that does not exist changes how they build and when they commit. Yone's W text says 'Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone' and grants a shield — it says nothing about true damage. Stand United carries the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'), and Mortal Steel at two stacks knocks enemies Airborne, so the Q3 knockup is an answer to a Shen ultimate cast in your lane.
audit.corrected: Ki Barrier is a shield, not sustain; Spirit Cleave is a shielding cone; and Stand United is a channel the Q3 knockup can cancel.

audit.why: The page already states that Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only — Riot's W text says 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked', so leading with abilities rather than autos through the zone is right.

edits.before: W shield-grit covers every exchange you start. Only take the trade when Shen's Shadow Dash is down.
edits.after: Stacked Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave out-trade Twilight Assault. Bait Shadow Dash, 18s at rank 1, first.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Shen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so lead with Mortal Steel and Spirit Cleave straight through it.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Shen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United is global, not a duel tool, and it is a channel — a Q3 knockup cancels it. You keep lane control at 6.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shadow Dash's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — a 150-energy Shadow Dash leaves him nothing to answer with.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Shen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and you out-DPS him 1v1. His real threat is Stand United on 200s — punish the map while it is spent.

edits.before: On first item you shred his tanky base faster than Vorpal Blade can heal.
edits.after: On first item you shred his base faster than Ki Barrier can shield it.

edits.before: Shen R (Stand United) is global, not a duel tool, so 1v1 he gains nothing at 6 while your Fate Sealed lets you all-in through his Vorpal Blade sustain.
edits.after: Shen R (Stand United) is global, not a duel tool, so 1v1 he gains nothing at 6 — and it is a channel, so a Q3 knockup cancels a cast made in your lane.

edits.before: Poke you with sword Q and sustain on Vorpal Blade passive
edits.after: Poke with Twilight Assault and re-shield on Ki Barrier

edits.before: Through 3-6 you own every duel: stacked Q knockups and W's true-damage cleave out-trade Shen's Twilight Assault, and his level-6 R does nothing for a 1v1. Play the wave to deny his roam and force him to babysit lane.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you own every duel: stacked Q knockups and Spirit Cleave's shield out-trade Shen's Twilight Assault, and Stand United does nothing 1v1 — it is a channel your Q3 knockup can cancel. Play the wave to deny his roam.

edits.before: Even after items Shen stays a peel tank you simply out-DPS in a straight fight. Track his R timer, punish holstered windows, and don't let his global saves undo your lead — split and pressure objectives while he's forced to react.
edits.after: Even after items Shen stays a peel tank you simply out-DPS in a straight fight. Stand United is 200 seconds at rank 1 — the moment he spends it, take your objective and pressure the side lane while he is stuck reacting to you.

notes: Biggest find, and the packet flagged none of it (defects and suspectNames were both empty): 'Vorpal Blade' appears twice as Shen's sustain. That ability is not in his kit — the passive is Ki Barrier and it grants a shield, not healing. This is the same failure mode as the calibration examples, and it was steering both the itemisation logic and the first-item spike. Second: the page called Yone's Spirit Cleave a 'true-damage cleave'; Riot's W text says only that it damages a cone and grants a shield, so the claim is unsupported and was removed rather than restated. Stand United's interruptibility is taken from the kit's channel flag rather than Riot's prose, so it is written as a cancel on the cast, not as a guaranteed counter to a completed teleport.
